mapper.select: SELECT *, id::text AS id, submission_id::text AS submission_id, definition_json::text AS definition_json FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT *, id::text AS id, submission_id::text AS submission_id, definition_json::text AS definition_json FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE creator = #{actor} AND application_id = CAST(#{app} AS bigint) AND object_id = CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND request_key = #{key} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_handling_request(id, application_id, application_name, application_version, object_id, object_name, entry_id, record_id, operation, name, request_key, request_digest, definition_checksum, definition_json, submission_id, process_definition_id, process_definition_key, status, creator, updater) VALUES (CAST(#{r.id} AS uuid), #{r.applicationId}, #{r.applicationName}, #{r.applicationVersion}, #{r.objectId}, #{r.objectName}, #{r.entryId}, #{r.recordId}, #{r.operation}, #{r.name}, #{r.requestKey}, #{r.requestDigest}, #{r.definitionChecksum}, CAST(#{r.definitionJson} AS jsonb), #{r.submissionId}, #{r.processDefinitionId}, #{r.processDefinitionKey}, #{r.status}, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_handling_request SET process_instance_id = #{instance}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND (process_instance_id IS NULL OR process_instance_id = #{instance}) AND deleted = 0

UPDATE public.nocode_handling_request SET status = #{state}, record_id = COALESCE(#{record}, record_id), error = #{error}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND lock_version = #{revision} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE object_id = CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND record_id = #{record} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPLY_PENDING', 'APPLY_FAILED') AND (CAST(#{except} AS text) IS NULL OR id::text != #{except}) AND deleted = 0)
SELECT id::text FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE status = 'APPLY_PENDING' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY update_time LIMIT 20
